wires.evidence_or_condition: Battery model listing found (S5); physical battery terminals, short-circuit rating, and shortest unfused lead to F1 must be verified.
Main fuse F1 current, DC voltage (>=32 V DC), interrupting capacity, and holder rating TBD (S6).
Master switch SW1 DC inductive breaking rating and insulated BUS+ distribution block hardware TBD (S7).
Light branch fuse FL rating, DC interrupting capacity, and time-current curve TBD at BUS+ takeoff (S6).
Light current transducer S_L series primary input; orient IP+ toward source so forward current gives positive signal.
Feeds complete 12 V DC lamp input boundary; exact lamp wattage and internal driver TBD.
Dedicated Light return conductor home-run to JGND.STAR_RETURN; do not daisy-chain with Motor or ESP32 ground.
Motor branch fuse FM rating, time-delay I2t curve for motor startup, and DC breaking capacity TBD at BUS+ takeoff.
ACS712-30A candidate primary input IP+; breakout PCB trace and screw terminal ampacity must be verified.
Measures DC supply current entering motor controller MDRV, not switched PWM motor winding current.
Dedicated high-current Motor return conductor home-run directly to JGND.STAR_RETURN to prevent ground-bounce on ADC reference.
Electronics branch fuse F2 rating TBD (0.391 A buck calculation is a load budget example, not a fuse rating).
Candidate LM2596 IC rated 4.5-40 V input (S4); verify actual converter module input capacitor and polarity markings.
Converter input return path via battery negative star; explicitly drawn in upgraded schematic (was omitted in prior SVG).
Pre-adjust and verify 5.00 V output under load before connecting U_ESP; verify USB/5V_IN backfeed isolation on ESP32 board.
Explicitly drawn in upgraded schematic; valid only after confirming U_BUCK_BOARD is non-isolated with continuous common IN-/OUT- ground.
Dedicated quiet logic ground reference between ESP32 GND and JGND.LOGIC_GND (never daisy-chain with MDRV return).
5.00 V supply to ACS712 (4.5-5.5 V datasheet range, S1); power sequencing must prevent S_M driving GPIO34 while U_ESP is unpowered.
Motor current sensor signal ground referenced to quiet JGND.LOGIC_GND.
Supply rail for S_L (5.0 V or 3.3 V depending on selected Light current transducer, e.g., INA219 uses 3.3 V).
Light current sensor reference ground to JGND.LOGIC_GND.
Unified designator U_I_L (previously mismatched as R_I_L in BOM); conditioning network TBD after S_L selection.
Routes conditioned Light current signal to classic ESP32 ADC1_CH4 candidate GPIO32 (must stay within 0.15-2.45 V).
Kelvin voltage sense tap at Light branch DC input boundary (paired with S_L current boundary).
